verdict.rationale: Plaid documents webhooks that programmatically notify you about Item changes and async process status, including keeping transactions up to date. This gives developers event triggers to build their own automation, but the evidence shows no native way to define rules that fire actions automatically; all rule logic and actions must live in the customer's own code. Missing for 10: a native rules engine or condition builder, Plaid-executed automated actions on events, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
